model.scope: Route only exact, digest-bound Python recipes to their own author and provenance-locked verifier implementations.
model.binding: The registry digest covers sorted entry descriptors; each descriptor covers recipe, builder, author receipt, verifier runner, provenance class, and refusal of general authoring or arbitrary execution.
model.extension: Adding a recipe changes the registry digest and therefore invalidates old manifest/selection/authorization combinations until a host explicitly approves the new binding.
